definitions.gloss: mother and child; mother and her child/children
definitions.explanation: Refers to a mother and her child or children as a unit. Frequently used in official, medical, and social welfare contexts.

examples.japanese: {母子|ぼし}ともに{健康|けんこう}です。
examples.english: Both mother and child are healthy.

examples.japanese: {母子|ぼし}{手帳|てちょう}をもらった。
examples.english: I received a maternal and child health handbook.

examples.japanese: {母子|ぼし}{家庭|かてい}を{支援|しえん}するための{制度|せいど}が{充実|じゅうじつ}してきた。
examples.english: Systems to support single-mother households have become more comprehensive.

notes:
Compound of {母|ぼ} (mother) + {子|し} (child). A formal compound used primarily in institutional and official contexts.

USAGE:
Very common in healthcare, social welfare, and legal contexts. The {母子|ぼし}{手帳|てちょう} (maternal and child health handbook) is given to every pregnant woman in Japan and is used to record the health of both mother and child throughout pregnancy and early childhood. {母子|ぼし}{家庭|かてい} is the formal term for a single-mother household.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {母子|ぼし}{手帳|てちょう} — maternal and child health handbook
- {母子|ぼし}{家庭|かてい} — single-mother household
- {母子|ぼし}{健康|けんこう} — maternal and child health
- {母子|ぼし}{分離|ぶんり} — separation of mother and child
- {母子|ぼし}ともに — both mother and child

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {父子|ふし} — father and child
- {親子|おやこ} — parent and child (either parent, warmer/more casual)
- {母娘|おやこ}/{母娘|ははむすめ} — mother and daughter
